beats.label: S1 · A distress call in the Belt
beats.text: Ice hauler XO Jim Holden's crew answers a distress call from an empty Belter freighter. A stealth ship destroys the Canterbury behind them, leaving only their shuttle alive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Inciting event: every plotline in the season traces back to the Canterbury's destruction.

beats.label: S1 · Holden blames Mars
beats.text: Holden broadcasts that Martian tech killed the Canterbury, and the Belt riots. Avasarala reads Mars's reaction and realises neither planet did this — someone else wants a war.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the three-way Earth-Mars-Belt tension the whole show runs on and puts Avasarala on the trail of a hidden third party.

beats.label: S1 · The Rocinante
beats.text: Stealth ships destroy the Martian flagship carrying Holden's crew. They escape in a captured frigate, rename it Rocinante, and shelter with Fred Johnson's OPA at Tycho.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns the Canterbury survivors into the crew and ship that carries the rest of the series, tied to Fred Johnson.

beats.label: S1 · Miller finds Julie
beats.text: Fired detective Miller keeps chasing Julie Mao to Eros and finds Holden there. They discover Julie dead, coated in a strange organic substance.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Miller joins Holden's story and the protomolecule surfaces as the actual thing behind the conspiracy.

beats.label: S1 · Eros as an incubator
beats.text: Mercenaries lock down Eros as a fake radiation drill and herd its poor into shelters to be infected with Julie's protomolecule. Holden and Miller take a lethal dose escaping.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals what the conspiracy is actually for — a live human trial — and leaves S2 opening on a quarantined station full of infected.

beats.label: S1 · The traitor above her
beats.text: Fred broadcasts proof the stealth ships were built on Earth. Avasarala catches Errinwright lying about them, names him the traitor above her, and moves her family to Luna.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in Errinwright as the UN antagonist and puts Avasarala on the opposite side of her own government.

cliffhanger.text: Eros is quarantined and dying as the protomolecule spreads through its trapped population. Holden's crew has fled with the truth, and Avasarala knows the traitor is her own boss.
questions: What is the protomolecule building on Eros?
Can Fred Johnson turn the Rocinante crew into leverage against Mao's conspiracy?
Can Avasarala outmanoeuvre Errinwright now that she knows he is the traitor?

characters.name: Jim Holden
characters.line: Ice hauler XO whose distress-call broadcast blaming Mars for the Canterbury sparked the war; now captain of the seized Martian frigate Rocinante, sheltering at Tycho and dosed with protomolecule on Eros.

characters.name: Joe Miller
characters.line: Belter detective fired from Star Helix for chasing Julie Mao; found her body on Eros with Holden and took a lethal dose of protomolecule escaping the station.

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: UN Deputy Undersecretary who saw that a third party engineered the war, unmasked Errinwright as the traitor above her, and moved her family to Luna.

characters.name: Sadavir Errinwright
characters.line: UN Undersecretary quietly steering Earth toward war; caught lying about the stealth ships once Fred's broadcast proved they were built on Earth.

characters.name: Fred Johnson
characters.line: Ex-Earth colonel turned OPA leader at Tycho Station, who took in Holden's crew and broadcast the proof that the stealth ships came from Earth.

characters.name: Julie Mao
characters.line: Idealist Belter-sympathiser heiress found dead on Eros, coated in the protomolecule that would consume the station.

characters.name: Jules-Pierre Mao
characters.line: Reclusive Earth industrialist whose Protogen subsidiary ran the Eros infection; Julie's estranged father and the money behind the protomolecule programme.

beats.label: S2 · Thoth Station
beats.text: Fred's Belters raid the Protogen lab and capture its scientist Dresden. When Dresden pitches the protomolecule as humanity's next step, Miller silences him with a bullet.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the protomolecule's chief scientist and defines Miller as someone who will act alone.

beats.label: S2 · Miller rides Eros to Venus
beats.text: Eros dodges every warhead and turns toward Earth. Miller stays behind with a bomb and talks the infected Julie inside into steering the asteroid into Venus instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends Eros, kills Miller, and plants the protomolecule on a whole planet — the ground the rest of the show sits on.

beats.label: S2 · Ganymede shatters
beats.text: On Ganymede, Bobbie Draper's Martian squad is butchered by a figure that walks in vacuum. The fleets above each blame the other, and the Belt's breadbasket burns from orbit.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the protomolecule hybrid weapon and gives Bobbie the memory that makes her a witness.

beats.label: S2 · Bobbie defects, Prax joins
beats.text: Sent to lie for Mars on Earth, Bobbie sees the vacuum-walker in Avasarala's files as a hybrid and defects. Botanist Prax joins the Rocinante to hunt his stolen daughter Mei.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two new load-bearing characters attach themselves to Avasarala and the Rocinante, and the Ganymede lie is broken.

beats.label: S2 · Errinwright's kill order
beats.text: Errinwright poisons Mars's defence minister and orders Avasarala killed on Mao's ship. Bobbie fights her out. On Venus, the Eros crash starts disassembling ships that study it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Errinwright openly commits murder to keep the conspiracy alive, and Venus starts behaving like a thing that is thinking.

beats.label: S2 · Naomi's confession
beats.text: On the Rocinante, Naomi tells Holden she kept the protomolecule sample and gave it to Fred so the Belt would have leverage. Mei is revealed alive, in stasis at a Mao lab on Io.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts a live protomolecule sample in Belter hands and points S3 straight at Io.

cliffhanger.text: The protomolecule has grown into a self-building structure on Venus that eats every ship that comes near it. Mei's hybrid programme is still running on Io, and Naomi has just told Holden that Fred Johnson holds a Belter copy of the sample.
questions: What is being built on Venus?
Can Avasarala survive long enough to bring Errinwright and Mao to account?
With Fred sitting on a protomolecule sample, is Naomi's loyalty still with the Rocinante?

characters.name: Jim Holden
characters.line: Captain of the Rocinante, now aware Naomi hid a protomolecule sample from him and handed it to Fred.

characters.name: Naomi Nagata
characters.line: Rocinante XO who confessed to Holden that she secretly kept the last protomolecule sample and gave it to Fred so the Belt would have leverage.

characters.name: Bobbie Draper
characters.line: Martian marine sergeant, sole survivor of the Ganymede attack; defected to Earth after seeing Avasarala's hybrid files and fought Avasarala clear of Mao's ship.

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: UN heavyweight who confronted Mao personally and barely escaped his ship alive with Bobbie, still hunting the protomolecule programme.

characters.name: Joe Miller
characters.line: Detective who rode a bomb down onto Eros and talked the infected Julie into steering the asteroid into Venus instead of Earth.

characters.name: Sadavir Errinwright
characters.line: UN Undersecretary now secretly driving the protomolecule play; poisoned Mars's defence minister and ordered the failed hit on Avasarala aboard Mao's yacht.

characters.name: Fred Johnson
characters.line: OPA leader at Tycho, now the sole holder of the Belt's protomolecule sample thanks to Naomi.

characters.name: Mei Meng
characters.line: Kidnapped daughter of a Ganymede botanist, revealed alive in stasis at a Mao lab on Io as part of the hybrid programme.

characters.name: Jules-Pierre Mao
characters.line: Fugitive industrialist whose Io lab holds Mei and the hybrid research the Rocinante is closing in on.

beats.label: S3 · Errinwright's war
beats.text: Errinwright frames Avasarala for Eros and pushes the UN into war with Mars. Bobbie and Avasarala flee Mao's ship on a racing yacht as missiles chase them across the system.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the season's political core: a full Earth-Mars war and Avasarala hunted as a traitor.

beats.label: S3 · Anna joins the fight
beats.text: The Rocinante rescues Bobbie and Avasarala mid-flight. On Earth, pastor Anna joins the Secretary General's circle and watches Errinwright rewrite her peace speeches into war.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites the political and shipboard arcs and introduces Anna as a moral spine on Earth's side.

beats.label: S3 · Io lab shut down
beats.text: The crew raids Mao's Io lab and reunites Prax with Mei. Fred destroys Errinwright's hybrid missiles, and Errinwright is arrested with Mao delivered to Avasarala as a prisoner.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the big Season 1-2 villains in one stroke, freeing the show to open the Ring plot.

beats.label: S3 · The Ring appears
beats.text: The protomolecule builds a huge structure beyond Uranus: the Ring. Earth, Mars, and the Belt each send a fleet, with the OPA finally recognised as the Belt's government.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the show's whole board and gives the Belt real standing as a power.

beats.label: S3 · Clarissa's revenge
beats.text: Julie's sister Clarissa Mao rides the fleet under a fake identity to destroy Holden. She frames him for a bomb attack and blows an Earth ship apart to sell it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Clarissa, whose arc runs long past this season.

beats.label: S3 · Miller opens the gates
beats.text: Chased into the Ring, the Rocinante is trapped in a pocket dimension. A ghostly Miller leads Holden to the Ring's core, which then opens 1300 more Rings to new worlds.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Rings open — every future story about colonies, Marco, and Laconia sits on this beat.

cliffhanger.text: The Ring has opened gateways to 1,300 new habitable systems. Earth, Mars, and the Belt now stare into a colonisation rush, and nobody understands what killed the makers of the Rings.
questions: Who reaches the new worlds first — the Inners or the Belt?
What killed the civilisation that built the Rings?
Can the OPA hold together as a real government or split under the pressure?

characters.name: Jim Holden
characters.line: Rocinante captain framed by a bomb attack, then chased into the Ring, where a ghostly Miller led him to a core that opened 1300 more gates.

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: Won the war of nerves against Errinwright, took Mao as a prisoner, and saw the OPA seated as the Belt's recognised government.

characters.name: Sadavir Errinwright
characters.line: UN schemer arrested for framing Avasarala, pushing Earth into war with Mars, and building the hybrid missile programme.

characters.name: Bobbie Draper
characters.line: Martian marine attached to Avasarala's circle; helped rescue Mei from Io and joined the fleet chasing the Ring.

characters.name: Fred Johnson
characters.line: OPA leader at Tycho, now the Belt's official head of state, whose people destroyed Errinwright's hybrid missiles.

characters.name: Jules-Pierre Mao
characters.line: Industrialist arrested after his Io hybrid lab fell, delivered to Avasarala as a prisoner alongside Errinwright.

beats.label: S4 · Gold rush at the gates
beats.text: Avasarala blockades the Rings to hold off a colony rush. Belter refugees still beat an Earth mining charter to a planet called Ilus, and the Rocinante is sent as her envoy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets S4's political fault line: Avasarala trying to hold back a rush the Belt is desperate for.

beats.label: S4 · Ilus turns hostile
beats.text: On Ilus, Earth's charter and the Belter settlers slide toward war. Guided by a Miller ghost, Holden reactivates an alien machine that wakes the planet's ruins.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Miller returns, and the setup for the season's climax — dormant protomolecule tech coming alive — is planted.

beats.label: S4 · Marco Inaros surfaces
beats.text: At the Ring, Ashford and Drummer catch Belter pirate Marco Inaros — Naomi's ex and father of her son Filip. An OPA vote lets him walk, and he keeps building his fleet.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the antagonist of the next season and ties him to Naomi through Filip.

beats.label: S4 · Bobbie on a broken Mars
beats.text: On Mars, Bobbie falls in with a gang stealing military hardware and finds Martian officers selling warships to Belters. She funnels the intel to Avasarala.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Uncovers the Mars–Free Navy arms pipeline that becomes S5's other war.

beats.label: S4 · Miller shuts Ilus down
beats.text: Ilus's ruins nearly kill everyone. Miller's ghost builds himself a body from parts of the planet and walks into an alien artifact that shuts every ruin down at once.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the Ilus threat and, with Miller gone through the artifact, closes Holden's investigator arc.

beats.label: S4 · Marco throws the rocks
beats.text: Ashford corners Marco and dies at Filip's hand, hiding a warning no one finds. Avasarala loses her election, and Marco fires Mars-cloaked asteroids toward Earth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every S5 opening beat starts here: Ashford's buried tape, Avasarala out of power, rocks in flight.

cliffhanger.text: Marco Inaros is a real war now. Unmarked, Mars-cloaked asteroids are on their way to Earth, Ashford's recording of his plans is buried on an empty ship, and Avasarala — the one person who might have believed the warning coming — has just lost office.
questions: Can Earth spot the cloaked asteroids in time to shoot them down?
Who will ever find Ashford's recording?
What does Marco actually want the Belt to become?

characters.name: Jim Holden
characters.line: Rocinante captain sent as Avasarala's envoy to the first Ring colony Ilus, where Miller's ghost guided him to reactivate the alien machinery beneath the planet.

characters.name: Naomi Nagata
characters.line: Rocinante XO whose Belter pirate ex Marco Inaros — and their son Filip — resurface as Marco walks free of the OPA vote and builds his fleet.

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: UN Secretary General who blockaded the Rings against a colony rush; loses her election just as Marco's cloaked asteroids launch toward Earth.

characters.name: Marco Inaros
characters.line: Belter pirate spared by an OPA vote at the Ring; killed Ashford through Filip and fired Mars-cloaked asteroids toward Earth.

characters.name: Bobbie Draper
characters.line: Ex-Martian marine running with a Mars gang stealing military hardware, funneling Avasarala evidence that officers are selling warships to Belters.

characters.name: Camina Drummer
characters.line: Senior OPA captain who helped hunt Marco to the Ring but was overridden by the vote that let him walk.

characters.name: Klaes Ashford
characters.line: OPA elder who tracked Marco down alone and was killed by Filip while hiding a warning no one has yet found.

characters.name: Filip Inaros
characters.line: Naomi and Marco's teenage son, now his father's loyal enforcer, who personally executed Ashford.

characters.name: Joe Miller
characters.line: The dead detective's protomolecule ghost, who built himself a body from the ruins of Ilus and walked into an artifact to shut every alien ruin down at once.

beats.label: S5 · The crew scatters
beats.text: The Rocinante crew splits. Naomi heads to Pallas to find Filip, Amos to Earth to bury his past, Alex home to Mars, and Bobbie hunts Martian arms sales for Avasarala.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts every crew member on their own thread — the structure the whole season runs on.

beats.label: S5 · Naomi finds Filip
beats.text: On Pallas, Naomi finds a grown Filip loyal to Marco. His people take her captive, and she learns the Free Navy is planning something far larger than Belter piracy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Marco and Filip step onto the page as a family, and Naomi is inside his ship when the war starts.

beats.label: S5 · Gaugamela
beats.text: Marco's cloaked rocks strike Earth, killing millions. His Tycho agent kills Fred Johnson and steals the protomolecule sample. Marco declares his Free Navy the Belt's new ruler.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The turning point of the whole show: Earth broken, Fred dead, protomolecule in Marco's hands, war declared.

beats.label: S5 · Drummer folds
beats.text: Drummer's clan is cornered into joining Marco or dying. She reluctantly signs, and Marco's officer Karal is placed on her ship to watch her every move.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks Drummer inside the Free Navy — her later break from it is what tips the war.

beats.label: S5 · The Chetzemoka trap
beats.text: Marco rigs Filip's ship Chetzemoka as a bomb to lure the Rocinante in. Naomi leaps unsuited to it and distorts the signal into a warning; Cyn dies trying to stop her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Naomi's escape saves the Rocinante and plants the death that cracks Filip's loyalty to Marco.

beats.label: S5 · Alex dies saving her
beats.text: Alex and Bobbie reach Naomi first and pull her from vacuum, but Alex dies of a stroke on the burn. The crew regroups on Luna under Secretary-General Avasarala.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Alex is gone, the crew is smaller and reunited on Luna, Avasarala is back on top.

beats.label: S5 · Something at the gates
beats.text: Marco's Free Navy seizes the Ring gates with Martian defectors. A defector ship reaches Laconia where the protomolecule blooms, and something inside the Ring devours another mid-transit.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Laconia and the Ring entities — the two threats S6 opens on.

cliffhanger.text: Marco's Free Navy owns the Ring gates and the protomolecule sample. Beyond one gate, a stolen Martian ship has reached Laconia and the protomolecule there has just come alive — and something invisible inside the Ring has eaten another warship whole.
questions: What is being built on Laconia?
What lives inside the Ring space, and why is it hunting now?
Can Avasarala's coalition retake the gates before Marco entrenches?

characters.name: Naomi Nagata
characters.line: Held captive on Pallas by Filip's people, then escaped by leaping unsuited to the rigged Chetzemoka and distorting its signal into a warning; now recovering on Luna.

characters.name: Amos Burton
characters.line: Rocinante mechanic caught on Earth when Marco's asteroids fell; fought his way back off-planet and rejoins the crew on Luna.

characters.name: Marco Inaros
characters.line: Free Navy admiral whose cloaked asteroids killed millions on Earth; declared himself the Belt's ruler and seized the Ring gates with Martian defectors.

characters.name: Filip Inaros
characters.line: Marco's son and lieutenant, complicit in the strike on Earth and in Marco's plan to bait Naomi with the rigged Chetzemoka.

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: Restored as Secretary General on Luna, coordinating what's left of Earth's response and hosting the Rocinante crew as they regroup.

characters.name: Bobbie Draper
characters.line: Hunting Martian arms sales to Belters for Avasarala, and one of the two who pulled Naomi from vacuum after the Chetzemoka leap.

characters.name: Alex Kamal
characters.line: Rocinante pilot returned home to Mars; died of a stroke on the hard burn to reach Naomi, moments after helping save her.

characters.name: Camina Drummer
characters.line: OPA captain cornered into swearing loyalty to Marco to save her clan; Marco's officer Karal now sits on her ship watching her.

beats.label: S6 · A child on Laconia
beats.text: On the colony world Laconia, a girl named Cara befriends alien 'dogs' that fix broken things. Admiral Duarte's scientist activates the alien structure orbiting the planet.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Laconia's power — resurrection tech and an intact protomolecule structure — quietly, off to one side of the war.

beats.label: S6 · Azure Dragon
beats.text: The Rocinante captures the Azure Dragon, the ship coordinating Marco's asteroid strikes. Its data core shows every incoming rock and ends the bombing of Earth in one raid.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the asteroid campaign and swings the war's momentum toward the coalition.

beats.label: S6 · Drummer joins Avasarala
beats.text: Drummer finds Ashford's hidden recording of Marco and forwards it to Fred's people. She then breaks with the Free Navy and openly allies with Avasarala.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The tape from S4 finally lands, Drummer defects, and the Belt has a face on the coalition side.

beats.label: S6 · Holden spares Filip
beats.text: The Joint Fleet catches Marco's flagship Pella. Bobbie fires a killing torpedo, but Holden disarms it when he sees Filip on the deck. Marco escapes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Marco lives to reach the Ring; Naomi's son becomes a plot lever, not just a wound.

beats.label: S6 · Laconia comes alive
beats.text: On Laconia, Cara loses her brother and asks the 'dogs' to fix him. He returns wrong. Duarte's scientist pushes the protomolecule work further using the sample Marco supplied.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows what Duarte actually has — resurrection and protomolecule together — the seed for whatever the show becomes past the war.

beats.label: S6 · Filip walks away
beats.text: Disillusioned with his father, Filip slips off the Pella on a skiff before Marco's final push at the Ring. His absence goes unseen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Filip survives the finale and is left loose in the Belt — the open thread the series ends on.

beats.label: S6 · The Rings take Marco
beats.text: Naomi wakes the Ring entities as Marco's fleet crosses. They eat the Pella and most of the Free Navy. Earth, Mars, and the Belt form a Transport Union led by Drummer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the war, kills Marco, and installs the political settlement — Drummer running the Rings — that the show leaves in place.

cliffhanger.text: The Free Navy is gone and Drummer runs the Rings from a new Transport Union. But on Laconia, Admiral Duarte holds an intact protomolecule sample, alien creatures that resurrect the dead as something else, and nobody in Sol knows he is there.
questions: What is Duarte building on Laconia?
Where does Filip go now that he has walked away from the Free Navy?

characters.name: Jim Holden
characters.line: Rocinante captain attached to the Joint Fleet, who ended Marco's asteroid campaign by capturing the Azure Dragon and disarmed Bobbie's killing shot at the Pella when he saw Filip aboard.

characters.name: Naomi Nagata
characters.line: Rocinante XO who woke the Ring entities during Marco's crossing, letting them devour the Pella and most of the Free Navy.

characters.name: Marco Inaros
characters.line: Free Navy leader whose asteroid war has collapsed; killed with the Pella when the Ring entities took the ship on his final push.

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: Secretary General who oversaw the war's end and the founding of a Transport Union to share the Ring gates among Earth, Mars and the Belt.

characters.name: Camina Drummer
characters.line: Broke from the Free Navy after finding Ashford's recording of Marco; now the elected head of the new Transport Union.

characters.name: Bobbie Draper
characters.line: Rocinante's marine, who fired the killing torpedo at the Pella before Holden overrode it.

characters.name: Filip Inaros
characters.line: Disillusioned with his father, slipped off the Pella on a skiff before Marco's final push; his absence during the Ring entities' attack went unseen.

characters.name: Winston Duarte
characters.line: Admiral of the Martian defectors on Laconia, whose scientist activated the alien structure orbiting the planet and pushed the protomolecule work forward using Marco's sample.

characters.name: Cara
characters.line: A girl on Laconia who befriended the alien 'dogs' that fix broken things, and asked them to fix her dead brother — who came back wrong.
